This small plot is rented, so I will not waste my small money on chemical fertilizer — the land is not mine to improve. I plant cassava and small cocoyam here like last year, using the stems I saved from my own farm and some I get from my sister. The soil here in South South still gives small yield without fertilizer, especially with the good rain we get, and I will put the goat droppings I gather around the house to help the soil. I do most work myself with my children helping on weekends, and I only hire one or two people for clearing the bush at the start.
